headlines.title: 美国7月CPI速评
headlines.summary: 美国7月CPI同比增长3.4%，符合预期，前值为增长3.5%；美国7月核心CPI同比增长2.5%，追平2021年3月以来最低增速，且符合预期，前值为增长2.6%。数据显示美国7月基本通胀表现温和，或可缓解美联储加息的压力。这份报告显示，伊朗冲突引发的能源价格冲击影响在7月继续消退。这些数据可能给美联储更多空间，在考虑是否于9月15日至16日会议上提高借贷成本时，权衡通胀压力与近期招聘放缓之间的关系。在9月会议前，决策者还将看到更多就业和通胀报告。投资者也将密切关注美联储主席凯文·沃什预计本月晚些时候在央行年度杰克逊霍尔研讨会上的讲话。

headlines.title_en: Quick read on US July CPI
headlines.summary_en: US July CPI rose 3.4% year-on-year, in line with expectations, versus 3.5% previously; US July core CPI rose 2.5% year-on-year, matching the lowest pace since March 2021 and in line with expectations, versus 2.6% previously. Data show US underlying inflation was moderate in July, which may ease pressure on Fed rate hikes. The report indicates that the energy price shock from the Iran conflict continued to fade in July. These data may give the Fed more room to weigh inflation pressures against the recent slowdown in hiring when considering whether to raise borrowing costs at the September 15-16 meeting. Before the September meeting, policymakers will also see more employment and inflation reports. Investors will also closely watch Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech expected later this month at the central bank's annual Jackson Hole symposium.

headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_zh: 在香港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳的资产有何独特优势？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近一半物业找到买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合最初估值约为30亿港元（合3亿美元）。

headlines.title: 中国主动量化策略首度嵌入境外主动ETF
headlines.summary: 富国基金旗下全资子公司富国香港获银河国际证券（新加坡）有限公司委任为投资顾问，为一只聚焦新加坡本地中小市值股票的主动管理型权益ETF提供选股支持。据悉，该产品已启动发行，预计9月3日在新加坡交易所主板挂牌。近年来，公募“出海”持续升级。在境外机构设置方面，公募境外子公司已超30家，遍布新加坡、北美等地区；产品层面，互联互通发展如火如荼，互挂ETF相继落地，并联合境外多家资管机构发行基金产品，吸引海外资金投资A股。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: China's active quantitative strategy debuts in offshore active ETF
headlines.summary_en: Fullgoal Fund's wholly-owned subsidiary Fullgoal Hong Kong has been appointed as investment advisor by Galaxy International Securities (Singapore) Co., Ltd. to provide stock selection support for an actively managed equity ETF focused on Singapore-listed small and mid-cap stocks. The product has reportedly launched and is expected to list on the main board of the Singapore Exchange on September 3. In recent years, public fund "going global" has continued to upgrade. In terms of overseas institutional setup, public fund overseas subsidiaries have exceeded 30, spanning Singapore, North America, and other regions; at the product level, cross-border connectivity is developing rapidly, with cross-listed ETFs landing one after another, and fund products launched jointly with multiple overseas asset managers to attract overseas capital to invest in A-shares. (China Fund News)

headlines.title: 荣耀CEO李健：未来2~3年将迎来AI终端设备大爆发
headlines.summary: 荣耀CEO李健在接受采访时表示，“整个消费电子行业，甚至可能以外与内存存在强相关的行业，实际上都面临着极大的压力，全球的市场空间是在压缩的。但另外一方面也有机会，未来2~3年一定是AI终端设备大爆发的时间，我跟团队对此都特别有信心，两三年后再回过头来看，行业会发生变化。”（科创板日报）

headlines.title_en: Honor CEO Li Jian: AI terminal devices set for major boom in next 2-3 years
headlines.summary_en: Honor CEO Li Jian said in an interview, "The entire consumer electronics industry, and perhaps even industries strongly related to memory, are facing immense pressure, with global market space shrinking. But on the other hand, there are opportunities; the next 2-3 years will definitely be a boom period for AI terminal devices. My team and I are very confident about this, and in two to three years, looking back, the industry will change." (STDaily)

headlines.summary: 腾讯控股ADR盘初一度跌近4%，其第二季度营收2,047.9亿元，同比增长11%，第二季度录得负自由现金流人民币138亿元，若剔除算力采购的预付款项，自由现金流为人民币376亿元。

headlines.title_en: Tencent Holdings ADR initially fell nearly 4% in early trading
headlines.summary_en: Tencent Holdings ADR initially fell nearly 4% in early trading, with Q2 revenue of RMB 204.79 billion, up 11% year-on-year, and negative free cash flow of RMB 13.8 billion in Q2; excluding prepayments for computing power procurement, free cash flow was RMB 37.6 billion.

headlines.title: ETF日报：短期内，黄金可能仍然受到经济数据、地缘扰动、美债收益率等因素带来一定波动
headlines.summary: 富国基金旗下全资子公司富国香港获银河国际证券（新加坡）有限公司委任为投资顾问，为一只聚焦新加坡本地中小市值股票的主动管理型权益ETF提供选股支持。据悉，该产品已启动发行，预计9月3日在新加坡交易所主板挂牌。近年来，公募“出海”持续升级。在境外机构设置方面，公募境外子公司已超30家，遍布新加坡、北美等地区；产品层面，互联互通发展如火如荼，互挂ETF相继落地，并联合境外多家资管机构发行基金产品，吸引海外资金投资A股。（中国基金报）

headlines.summary: 中国央行Q2货币政策执行报告：适度宽松货币政策效果持续显现，金融服务实体经济质效不断提升。 央行Q2货政报告专栏：逐步增加隔夜逆回购的操作频率，进一步畅通政策利率向市场利率的传导。 全面符合预期！美国7月CPI同比涨幅收窄至3.4%，核心CPI同比放缓至2.5%。 IEA警告：三季度原油供应缺口预期翻倍，全年缺口或创五年新高。 OPEC月报：下调2026年全球石油需求预测，沙特7月复产超百万桶/日。 腾讯Q2营收同比增长11%超预期，算力采购大幅推高资本开支至527.8亿元，自由现金流转负。 AI基础设施成为核心增长引擎！鸿海二季度营收同比劲增41%，上
